description: Satellite-detected flooded structures, as of 15 November 2019, over Libenge, Democratic Republic of the Congo is a hazard data set listed in Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX), an open data portal, published or maintained by United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT). UNOSAT code: FL20191118COD This map illustrates satellite-detected flooded structures along the Ubangui River over Libenge, Libenge Territory, Sud-Ubangui Territory in Democratic Republic of the Congo as observed from Pleiades imagery acquired on 15 November 2019. UNITAR-UNOSAT identified 22 potentially flooded structures west of Libenge, within the extent of this map. Coverage: Democratic Republic of the Congo. The portal files it under the publisher United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT). Its tags are flooding, geodata. It offers 2 resource(s) in GEODATABASE, SHP. The portal shows 2025-11-21 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-SA (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening for infrastructure. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hdx-humanitarian-data-exchange.
